sections.heading: Business
sections.markdown: Basic Materials / Other Industrial Metals & Mining · Indonesia. PT Trimegah Bangun Persada TBK engages in the nickel ore mining and processing in China, Switzerland, Indonesia, and Singapore. It offers ferronickel, saprolite ore, limonite ore, nickel sulfate, mixed hydroxide precipitate, cobalt sulfate, and electrolytic cobalt. The company was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Jakarta Pusat, Indonesia. PT Trimegah Bangun Persada Tbk is a subsidiary of PT Harita Jayaraya Inc.
